{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
                           (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Drop rows with missing revenue in this subset
loyal_completed_clean = loyal_completed.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Calculate mean revenue for the cleaned subset
mean_revenue_clean = loyal_completed_clean['revenue'].mean()

# Confirm the number of valid rows
n_valid = len(loyal_completed_clean)

n_valid, mean_revenue_clean"}
